comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: Budget is live on main. Handing off ownership to Editor platform.

content.text: Budget is live on main. Handing off ownership to Editor platform.

Editor first paint on mid-tier laptops (Intel i5-1135G7 class, 16GB RAM) regularly exceeds 3.2s LCP in field data, yet we have no CI gate that fails when a PR worsens that path. Mobile budgets exist; desktop editor is unchecked.

Add a Lighthouse CI budget job targeting the editor route with CPU 4x throttle and 4G Fast profile. Cap initial paint at 2.4s, TBT at 350ms, and total JS transferred at 420 KiB for the editor chunk graph.
Complete when the budget file lives in tooling/perf/editor-budget.json, the job runs on every editor-package PR, and the baseline commit is recorded in the perf dashboard.
